explanation_full: The Grey Relational Analysis (GRA) clearly establishes VFA as the most important feature, with a score of 0.7931. Butyrate and Acetate follow as the second and third most important features, respectively. In terms of model performance, the KNN model is superior, achieving the highest R² (0.81717) and the lowest MSE (0.012810) on the test set. These findings suggest that the organic acids (VFA, Butyrate, Acetate) are the primary drivers for predicting the target variable.
